## What it will cover

::: {.mm-stub-outline}
- Count matrices, normalisation and log transforms
- Quality control and batch effects
- PCA, UMAP and clustering of cells
- Differential expression and multiple testing
- Cell-type annotation with markers and classifiers
- Lab 11: a single-cell workflow on a small public dataset
:::

## Planned learning outcomes

1. Run a standard single-cell analysis pipeline with scanpy and interpret each step.
2. Recognise batch effects and confounding in omics data.
3. Train a cell-type classifier and evaluate it across batches.

## In the meantime

Everything here builds on Part I, in particular the evaluation habits of [Chapter 2](../../part-1-foundations/ch02-ml-fundamentals/index.html). Episode [2.6](../../part-1-foundations/ch02-ml-fundamentals/06-pipelines-leakage.html) already introduces the group splits that become sequence-identity splits here.
